question: What was the name of Swami Vivekanand’s guru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramakrishna Paramhansa**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ramakrishna Paramhansa** was the spiritual guru of Swami Vivekananda.
 
• Ramakrishna Paramhansa was a well-known saint and mystic of 19th-century Bengal.
 
• He played a crucial role in the Indian Renaissance and the revival of Hinduism in India.
